s: Habakkuk asks why God allows injustice. God answers that he is raising up the Chaldeans.
Write the vision plainly: the just shall live by his faith. Woes to the oppressor.
Habakkuk's prayer: though the fig tree does not blossom, I will rejoice in the Lord.

1: In older English “meat” meant any food, not only flesh.
2: Here: the inside or depths of something.
3: The bowels were thought of as the seat of feeling. Here: the heart, deep compassion.
